name: Tarô Caligula
source: Tarô Caligula isn't your average teenager. He’s strange (like really, really strange), to the point his only friend often get asked why he’s still hanging around him. Even though he doesn’t like to talk to people, his father asked him to organize a job interview to find a new employee for their farm. And then, Tarô’s world blew up…slowly...
